questions.question: When Jesus called the poor blessed in His sermon, what reason did He give them?

answers.text: Theirs is the kingdom of God

questions.question: When people hate Jesus' followers because of the Son of Man, what did Jesus tell them to do?
What did Jesus say about how people should treat others?

answers.text: Do to others as you would have them do to you
Treat others the way that they treat you
Do good to others when they have earned it

questions.question: When Jesus told people to love their enemies, what did He say the Most High is like?

answers.text: He is kind to the ungrateful and wicked
He shows kindness only to the faithful
He blesses the ones who bless Him
